demoTour.title: SFIC Hackathon 2-Minute Demo Workflow
demoTour.step1: 1. Aarav Patel (Class 4) struggled with Division Basics (35%).
demoTour.step2: 2. The AI Gap Engine flagged 'Needs Support' with transparent pedagogical reasoning.
demoTour.step3: 3. A 5-step concrete Remedial Plan was generated with manipulatives and practice.
demoTour.step4: 4. Complete the interactive Student Activity to test student learning.
demoTour.step5: 5. Record the Reassessment (85%) to see the +50 pp gain and 'Mastered' status!
